title: GE Appliances Reinvents Manufacturing Operations at Scale with Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise
claims_used: GE Appliances reports deploying more than 800 AI agents across manufacturing, logistics, and supply-chain operations. The manuscript uses the figure as evidence that some enterprises are already treating agents as a population of operational tools rather than a single assistant, while avoiding claims about independent productivity effects not established in the announcement.
caveat: The deployment count and impact descriptions are company-reported and should not be treated as an independent audit of capability or ROI.
